data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fattah', which means 'to open'. Fatoom can be translated to 'gift' or 'blessing'. In the Quran, the term is used to describe Allah's blessings upon his prophets and believers. The name Fatoom carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatoom usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
